text: All fixed. The root cause was in `page_count`: it used `total_items // per_page + 1`, which overcounts by one page whenever the item count is an exact multiple of `per_page` (9 // 3 + 1 = 4 instead of 3). I replaced it with ceiling division `max(1, (total_items + per_page - 1) // per_page)`, which keeps the documented "empty collection still has one page" behavior while fixing the phantom page. With the fix, `paginate(items, 3, 3)` on 9 items reports `total_pages=3`, `has_next=False` on the last page, and requesting page 4 raises `ValueError` as documented. The existing test suite passes, and I verified the issue scenario, the 10-items case, and the empty-collection edge case.
